terms.title: Agent
terms.description: A model-backed reviewer produced this record.

terms.title: Deterministic sensor
terms.description: A non-model tool or analyzer produced this record.

terms.title: Human
terms.description: A person produced this record directly.

terms.title: Imported
terms.description: This record was migrated from a legacy contract by an adapter.

terms.title: Unknown
terms.description: The producer could not be determined. Never defaulted to agent.

terms.title: Available
terms.description: The evidence needed for the assessment was collected.

terms.title: Partial
terms.description: Some but not all required evidence was collected.

terms.title: Unavailable
terms.description: No evidence was collected. This is a coverage state, not a pass or block.

terms.title: Pass
terms.description: The evidence establishes conformance.

terms.title: Concern
terms.description: The evidence raises a qualitative concern short of failure.

terms.title: Fail
terms.description: The evidence establishes non-conformance.

terms.title: Inconclusive
terms.description: The evidence does not establish either outcome.

terms.title: Not applicable
terms.description: The assessment does not apply to this subject.

terms.title: Not assessed
terms.description: The assessment has not run yet.

terms.title: Improved
terms.description: A before/after comparison shows improvement.

terms.title: Regressed
terms.description: A before/after comparison shows regression.

terms.title: Mixed
terms.description: A before/after comparison shows both improvement and regression.

terms.title: Unchanged
terms.description: A before/after comparison shows no material difference.

terms.title: No observed delta
terms.description: No before/after comparison was evidenced.

terms.title: Inconclusive
terms.description: The comparison evidence does not establish a direction.

terms.title: Allow
terms.description: Policy permits proceeding.

terms.title: Warn
terms.description: Policy permits proceeding with a recorded warning.

terms.title: Block
terms.description: Policy prevents proceeding.

terms.title: Defer
terms.description: Policy defers the disposition to a later or human decision.

terms.title: Critical
terms.description: The highest severity band.

terms.title: High
terms.description: A high severity band.

terms.title: Medium
terms.description: A medium severity band.

terms.title: Low
terms.description: A low severity band.

terms.title: Info
terms.description: An informational severity band.

terms.title: Open
terms.description: The issue has no disposition yet.

terms.title: Accepted risk
terms.description: The issue is knowingly accepted.

terms.title: Waived
terms.description: The issue is waived by policy.

terms.title: False positive
terms.description: The issue does not describe a real defect.

terms.title: Resolved
terms.description: The issue was fixed.

terms.title: Source code
terms.description: A reference into reviewed source.

terms.title: Test result
terms.description: A test execution outcome.

terms.title: Runtime measurement
terms.description: A measured runtime fact.

terms.title: Tool result
terms.description: Structured output from a deterministic tool.

terms.title: Artifact
terms.description: A stored file or generated artifact.

terms.title: Document
terms.description: Unstructured or prose evidence.

terms.title: Human attestation
terms.description: A person's direct statement.
